topic: Denim-on-Denim in 2026: How to Balance Washes, Fits and Proportions

serp_benchmark.structure: wash balance, non-blue denim, texture, fit, classic accessories, alternative denim pieces and product modules
three quick styling rules followed by seven outfit formulas and shopping modules
ten outfit formulas, wash and proportion rules, accessories and commercial CTA

content_gap: The ranking pages agree that matching and contrasting washes can both work, but they vary in how concretely they explain garment intersections. The Spykar article centres fitting-room checks: undertone, jacket hem versus rise, location of volume, inner-layer break and shoe-to-hem relationship.

duplicate_check.evidence: Spykar's live day-to-night denim guide contains one short double-denim subsection, while other repository drafts mention the look briefly. No standalone published Spykar wash-fit-proportion guide was found. The new article links to, rather than duplicates, the adjacent live guide.
